name: Sikh Scripture
translation: Selections from Japji Sahib and the Mul Mantar (classic English renderings)
note: Selections from the opening of the Guru Granth Sahib, the eternal Guru of the Sikhs — the Mul Mantar, the root formula of Sikh faith composed by Guru Nanak (1469-1539), and the opening stanzas of the Japji, recited by observant Sikhs every morning.
